qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the shouldered metal edge before installing the tail panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off shouldered metal edge on one side far enough that tail panel can be pushed behind the side panel.

qa_pairs.question: What type of welder should be used to weld the bottom of the tail panel to the side panels?
qa_pairs.answer: An inert gas welder should be used to weld the bottom of tail panel on left and right side panels.

qa_pairs.question: How should the tail panel be secured after fitting?
qa_pairs.answer: Fit in and tack weld tail panel.

qa_pairs.question: What type of welder is specified for welding the web of the tail panel to the side panels?
qa_pairs.answer: An autogen welder should be used to weld web of tail panel and left and right side panels in area of trunk lid.

qa_pairs.question: How is the tail panel mounted to the bumper bracket?
qa_pairs.answer: Mount tail panel on bumper bracket with a bolt.

qa_pairs.question: What welding method is used to attach the tail panel to the side panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Weld tail panel on side panel using spot welding.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the tail panel be spot welded in relation to the trunk floor?
qa_pairs.answer: Spot weld tail panel on trunk floor plate and bumper bracket.

qa_pairs.question: What is shown in image 30 41 053?
qa_pairs.answer: The image shows cutting off the shouldered metal edge on one side of the panel.

qa_pairs.question: What welding operation is shown in image 30 41 057?
qa_pairs.answer: The image shows welding the bottom of tail panel on left and right side panels with an inert gas welder.

qa_pairs.question: What is demonstrated in image 30 41 058?
qa_pairs.answer: The image shows welding the web of tail panel and left and right side panels in area of trunk lid with an autogen welder.

qa_pairs.question: What fastening method is shown in image 30 41 055?
qa_pairs.answer: The image shows mounting the tail panel on bumper bracket with a bolt.
